description: Trigger evals for team-update: it fires when the user wants a few short lines for a team channel about where the work stands, while pr-package, delivery-asset, where-we-at, branch-commit and sync-task-state handle the PR description, an audience-specific outward asset, a progress checkpoint, quick branch and commit naming, and task memory.

should_trigger: write me a quick slack note for the team, slices 1 and 2 are done and I'm starting on the migration tomorrow
Standup is in ten minutes. Give me two or three plain lines: the retry logic is merged into the feature branch, tests are green, and I'm waiting on a review of the config change.
can you draft a short message for the channel saying the planning is finished and we're ready to start coding
I need to tell my reviewers on the PR that I pushed fixes for their comments and that the last two items are still open. Keep it short and friendly.
quick update for the team on the auth work please

should_not_trigger.prompt: The diff against main is final. Write the PR title, the description, the list of files reviewers should look at first, and the git commands to push it.
Our director wants a one-page summary of what this project delivered, plus a five minute demo script for Thursday's all-hands.
I've lost track. Three slices are closed, one is half done. What is actually finished against the plan and what is left before we can call this complete?
I staged the changes for the pagination fix. Give me a branch name and a commit message that matches the diff.
I finished the parser slice and locked the retry decision this afternoon. Bring TASK_STATE.md up to date so I can pick this up in a fresh chat tomorrow.
